long_description: Wysa for Employers is an AI-powered mental health solution designed for workforce wellbeing programs. The platform provides employees with 24/7 access to an empathetic AI chatbot delivering evidence-based CBT, DBT, and mindfulness techniques. With over 5 million users globally and 20+ peer-reviewed publications validating its efficacy, Wysa has demonstrated significant reductions in depression and anxiety symptoms. The platform offers anonymous access to encourage employee engagement, validated assessments (PHQ-9, GAD-7), optional human coaching escalation, and employer dashboards with aggregate analytics. Wysa's FDA Breakthrough Device designation for chronic musculoskeletal pain demonstrates its expanding clinical validation.

faqs.a: Wysa provides employees with 24/7 access to an AI chatbot delivering CBT, DBT, and mindfulness techniques. Employees can access anonymously, track progress with PHQ-9/GAD-7 assessments, and escalate to human coaches when needed.
Yes, Wysa has 20+ peer-reviewed publications demonstrating efficacy in reducing depression and anxiety symptoms. It also received FDA Breakthrough Device designation for chronic musculoskeletal pain.
Yes, Wysa is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and GDPR compliant. BAA agreements are available for enterprise customers.
Yes, Wysa for Employers includes optional human coaching escalation for employees who need additional support beyond the AI chatbot.
